overview_description.description:
THYME is creating an ecosystem of time-based information, providing people with a way to manage their time easier and more effectively.

In today’s technology-driven world, more information is being shared across the Internet than ever, but the way people manage their time continues to be inefficient and cumbersome. Time is the most valuable asset we all have, putting THYME in the unique position to provide a solution to an undeniable pain.
